name: The Touch of Zanzil
label: Quest
description: The Touch of Zanzil: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's unanimous, friend. You've got the 'itis.'
Luckily, I have a cure for the 'itis.'

Here's what I need: One bundle of simple wildflowers, one leaded vial, one bronze tube, and last but certainly not least, one spool of light chartreuse silk thread. Ol' Emma left a spool of it for me at 'The Finest Thread.' You can find the shop along the canals.
Hurry along now, friend, and try not to touch anyone until you're cured. Oh, and Dr. Montgomery says you need a shower -- his words, not mine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you want the 'itis' cured, you're going to have to try harder than that, friend. Where are the reagents for the cure?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What am I doing? What does it look like I'm doing? I'm devising a cure for your 'itis!' Don't get indignant with me now, friend!
Just a few more seconds. There! Just spray this, um, fantastic smelling medicine on yourself and you'll be as good as new.
